newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Killinghall to buy S. Africa bank stake.
newsitem.headline: Killinghall to buy S. Africa bank stake.

text.p: Killinghall (Malaysia) Bhd said on Thursday it would take up a 50 percent stake in Southern Bank of Africa Investment Holdings Ltd (SBAIH) for 50 million rand in cash.
Killinghall said in a statement that the investment in SBAIH, the holding company of Southern Bank of Africa Ltd, would be funded by an offshore bank borrowing.
SBAIH will be incorporated in South Africa in the first quarter of 1997 with an initial paid-up share capital of 100 million rand comprising 100 million shares of one rand each.
Killinghall said approval had been granted by The Reserve Bank of South Africa on September 3, 1996 for Southern Bank to operate as a universal bank in South Africa.
Killinghall said the investment in SBAIH was in line with the company's objective to invest in the financial sector, both locally and overseas.
